card.name: Words after quantity phrases like more than one
card.fires_on: Words that follow a quantity or amount phrase, such as 'more than one capsule may' or 'a wide variety', right before the noun or verb the quantity governs. It is strongest after 'more than one' in dosing text.

modes.label: More than one unit
modes.description: Verb right after 'more than one capsule/vial' saying several are needed.
modes.example: When using capsules, more than one capsule<< may>> be needed to achieve recommended doses.

modes.label: Number or variety words
modes.description: Quantity nouns such as number, variety, species after 'higher' or 'wide'.
modes.example: through the use of a wide<< variety>> of technological and management practices.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence just after an amount phrase, such as 'more than one vial', where the sentence continues on how many are involved.
